# carrier inscription

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:carrierInscription`](gmeow-carrierInscription.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/carrierInscription>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)

The inscription(s) borne by a physical carrier. Non-functional: a carrier may bear multiple inscriptions (e.g. a tablet with text on both sides, or a wall with successive layers of graffiti).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) -> [`gmeow:Inscription`](../classes/gmeow-Inscription.md)
